purpose: Toys as designed play objects whose age suitability, material safety, child-led use, learning claims, household context, and version history need separate evidence.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name toy version, child age, setting, date, and jurisdiction. Do not certify safety from appearance or promise a developmental benefit from marketing or one play session.
